findings.title: DECODE_PREFETCH_WINDOWS and DB_WRITE_BATCH_SIZE were dead configuration
findings.evidence_before: service/app/ingestion/ingest.py:151 (pre-fix) drove decode, embed, and DB writes off a single batched(..., settings.embed_batch_size) loop; DECODE_PREFETCH_WINDOWS had zero references outside config.py; docs/DECISIONS.md:184-187 documented the collapse as intentional.
findings.residual_gap: If the decode source raises mid-way through filling a DECODE_PREFETCH_WINDOWS-sized prefetch group, already-decoded frames in that partial group are not explicitly released (relies on CPython refcounting). Bounded impact (<= DECODE_PREFETCH_WINDOWS records), not fixed this session.

findings.title: Frame ownership in iter_chunk_windows relied on implicit GC, not explicit close()
findings.evidence_before: service/app/ingestion/video.py iter_chunk_windows (pre-fix): source decode frame and last_frame were never explicitly .close()'d; no try/finally around the generator body, so an early GeneratorExit left buffered collected[] frames unclosed.
findings.residual_gap: No dedicated test added this session for early-GeneratorExit cleanup of iter_chunk_windows specifically; existing test_faz11_streaming.py suite (9 tests) still passes unchanged, confirming no behavior regression.
